title: AI-Mediation in Retail Markets: Revenue Effects and Assortment Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.12917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI shopping assistants increasingly influence which products consumers consider. We study retail assortment planning under AI mediation, where a retailer chooses a catalog, an AI intermediary forms a customer-facing shortlist, and the customer chooses from that shortlist according to a multinomial logit model. We consider both deterministic mediation, in which the AI follows a fixed segment-specific ranking, and stochastic mediation based on the Plackett-Luce model.   Empirically, we construct a dataset of product rankings from leading AI models, estimate Plackett-Luce ranking models, and evaluate their predictive performance on held-out assortments. Combining these estimates with synthetic customer preferences, we find that accounting for AI mediation can materially change optimal assortments and revenue. Across the tested capacity configurations, ignoring mediation yields mean revenue losses between 2.52% and 11.37% relative to the PL

translated_title: 零售市场中的AI中介：收入效应与商品组合优化
translated_abstract: AI购物助手日益影响着消费者会考虑购买哪些产品。我们研究了AI中介环境下的零售商品组合规划问题：零售商选择商品目录，AI中介机构形成面向顾客的候选清单，顾客根据多项Logit（MNL）模型从该候选清单中进行选择。我们考虑了两种中介方式：确定性中介，即AI遵循固定的、针对特定细分顾客群体的排序；以及基于Plackett-Luce模型的随机中介。在实证研究方面，我们构建了一个来自主流AI模型的产品排序数据集，估计了Plackett-Luce排序模型，并在留出的商品组合上评估了其预测性能。将这些估计与合成的顾客偏好相结合，我们发现将AI中介纳入考量能够实质性地改变最优商品组合与收入水平。在所测试的各种容量配置下，忽略中介效应会导致相对于PL模型的2.52%至11.37%的平均收入损失。
tldr: 该研究通过构建AI产品排序数据集并建立Plackett-Luce随机中介模型，证明在零售商品组合优化中纳入AI中介效应可将平均收入损失降低2.52%至11.37%，并显著改变最优商品组合的选择。
en_tdlr: Modeling AI intermediaries' product rankings via a Plackett-Luce framework materially changes optimal retail assortments, and ignoring AI mediation leads to mean revenue losses of 2.52% to 11.37%.
